warning: Do not cache this response. Do not send funds after the expiry.
notes: Base Asset: Send the inbound_address the asset with the memo encoded in hex in the data field. Tokens: First approve router to spend tokens from user: asset.approve(router, amount). Then call router.depositWithExpiry(inbound_address, asset, amount, memo, expiry). Asset is the token contract address. Amount should be in native asset decimals (eg 1e18 for most tokens). Do not swap to smart contract addresses. Do not use MWEB (ltcmweb1) addresses as the destination; they are not supported.
